messages:
maria_infra: Brought up stl1 cluster (4xA100 per rack). Can we run a quick perf validation before handing off to capacity?
ajay_ops: Awesome — what's the checklist you want? kernel/driver, net, and perf baselines?
maria_infra: Exactly. Priority order: driver/kernel compat, nvlink mesh checks, p95 latency baseline for gen and chat, throughput at batch sizes 1/4/8, and a cost estimate for steady state. Also verify quantized model runs (int8) for compatibility.
cheng_sre: I'll kick off driver checks. Tagging deploy-bot to show node images and kernel versions.
deploy-bot: nodes: stl1-rack-01..04; image: rwinf-2026-03-01; kernel: 5.19.14-rt; nvidia-driver: 535.86.10; cudnn: 8.9.1
ajay_ops: Quick NVLINK check: running `nvlink topo --all` on rack-02, looks healthy, full mesh on all 4 GPUs.
nora_perf: Starting generation benchmark on one node with model=gptx-13b-quantized-int8, seq=512, batch=1 then 4 then 8. Script: `./bench/gen_load.sh --model gptx-13b-q8 --seq 512 --batch $B`
maria_infra: Paste first run numbers when ready. We'll compare to baseline from iad1. Target p95 token latency <= 60ms for batch=1. throughput target >= 120 tokens/s per GPU at batch=8 (aggregate enough to meet SLOs).
nora_perf: Run results (node stl1-rack-02-gpu0):
```
batch=1 p50=21ms p95=58ms tokens_s=95
batch=4 p50=28ms p95=72ms tokens_s=260
batch=8 p50=40ms p95=110ms tokens_s=520
```
maria_infra: Hmm p95 for batch=8 is higher than expected. What's kernel-mode and preemption settings?
cheng_sre: Kernel is 5.19.14-rt, we have HZ tuned to 1000, preempt=voluntary. I'll flip to preempt=full on a test node to see.
ajay_ops: Also check PCIe link speeds, saw one link at x8 Gen3 instead of x16 Gen4 on rack-03 GPU1 earlier — could be riser seating.
maria_infra: Good catch. Can we mark rack-03-gpu1 as degraded and rerun?
deploy-bot: update: rack-03-gpu1 flagged `link_down_degrade` in inventory.
nora_perf: After removing rack-03 from the run and flipping preempt=full on rack-02:
```
batch=8 p50=36ms p95=88ms tokens_s=540
batch=1 p95=52ms tokens_s=102
```
maria_infra: Better. Still want to validate kernel module params: `nvidia-smi topo -m`, confirm nvlink counters, and check for Xid errors in dmesg.
cheng_sre: dmesg: a couple Xid 13 transient on rack-03-gpu1 before we pulled it, none on rack-02 after preempt flip. nvlink counters within expected.
ajay_ops: Cost note: estimated steady-state (4 racks, 16 GPUs) at current instance pricing ~ $28k/mo raw infra; with batching/cache savings expect ~25% lower token cost compared to iad baseline.
maria_infra: Action items: 1) Replace riser on rack-03-gpu1 and re-provision. 2) Apply preempt=full to nodes in stl1 for 48h soak. 3) Run full perf matrix (models: gptx-13b, llama2-70b-quant) across seq 128/512/1024 and batch 1/4/8. 4) Handoff doc for capacity with numbers + degraded node list.
cheng_sre: I'll create a short runbook PR with commands we used and the `sysctl` change.
maria_infra: Cool — if we get clean numbers in 48h we can mark stl1 as green for capacity. tagging @ajay_ops for cost signoff when perf matrix finishes. :thumbsup:
ajay_ops: Will review cost numbers once perf matrix is in.
